verdict.rationale: monday.com's apps framework explicitly supports creating custom board views, item views, dashboard widgets, and full-page apps (monday-docs-3). Vibe, its open-source React component library, is documented as making apps look native from day one (monday-docs-4, monday-docs-25). The menu-action extension points add to this (monday-docs-18). The community complaints are about general product usability, not this capability, so they were not weighed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom views and widgets built with Vibe actually feel native, and in-depth first-party documentation beyond marketing-level claims.
